Classic Smile.tip: Keep shoulders relaxed and smile naturally into the camera.

Tilt & Glamour.tip: Tilt your head 15°-25° to highlight your jawline and key features!

Hand on Chin.tip: Rest your hand gently under your chin for a thoughtful, chic aesthetic.

Peace & Vibe.tip: Bring your hand up near your cheek with a peace or cute gesture.

Side Profile.tip: Turn your face 45° away from camera to capture a sharp side profile.

Rule of Thirds.tip: Position your face along the vertical grid line for a cinematic model shot.
